vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --domains --sift b --polyphen b --protein [--tab|--vcf|--json]
input: 91 small-variant records on chromosome 21 chosen from the converted Ensembl VEP 116 cache's own matrices and protein features: single-base substitutions whose alternate residue each SIFT category (tolerated, deleterious and both low-confidence forms) and each PolyPhen HumVar category (probably damaging, possibly damaging, benign, unknown) predicts, inside and outside a protein feature, on forward and reverse transcripts; substitutions on transcripts with a SIFT matrix and no PolyPhen one; start codon changes with and without a matrix, synonymous changes, stop gains and losses; an inframe deletion, a frameshift insertion, two- and three-base substitutions within one codon and across two, an inframe insertion between the last residue of one feature and the first of the next, and one at a feature's first residue; a 5' UTR position, an intron and an intergenic position. Chosen over transcripts whose coding neighbours add the fewest matrix bytes to the cache; the reference base is the GRCh38 primary assembly's

divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

generator: candidate records annotated with Ensembl VEP under the corpus flags, then scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite pool38=<reference>=<candidates> --k 200 --seed 1 --cache <converted slice> --family-columns SIFT,PolyPhen,DOMAINS --covers ... --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--domains --flag=--sift --flag=b --flag=--polyphen --flag=b --flag=--protein; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except naming the coding transcripts the records reach, so those keep protein_features and protein_function_predictions and every other transcript drops them --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl converted from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh38 cache; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify
